Pose - Hero Stance.description:
🕴️ Pose: Hero Stance
A wide, grounded power pose — feet planted, shoulders squared, chin up. Confident and commanding.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Hero Stance.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, use a deliberate heroic posture with squared shoulders, lifted chest, stable center of gravity, and frame-visible hands relaxed or ready. Do not force feet, stance width, or ground contact outside the crop. Female: chest lifted with the shoulder line level, weight settled. Male: shoulders squared, chest out, weight planted. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own heroic carriage.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
